title: <Project name> 240 s pitch: narration, one beat per section (copy to story.json)

beats.text: One concrete, human moment or number that makes the problem real. Question at the end.
We are <team>, from <place>. <One sentence: why you care.> Our answer: <ProjectName>, <six-word promise>.
The problem in the challenge's own words, with one real NASA fact or number and why it matters now.
What it is, in one breath, and who uses it.
Walk through the main flow, one action per sentence, each sentence matches what is on screen.
Second feature. Show the result, not the menu.
Third feature or the wow moment (live data, 3D, simulation, hardware working).
How it works: the data or NASA source, the method or model, what runs where. One sentence each.
Proof it is grounded: which NASA datasets, papers or missions it uses, and what you measured or validated.
Honest limits (prototype, what is synthetic) and what you need to go further.
